basis: WOX4 drives cambial cell division (PttWOX4 RNAi, Kucukoglu et al. 2017 New Phytol); enriched in cambial clusters of Chen 2021 (cl1/2, 0.69/0.33) and Schmidt 2025 (c10/c5, 0.78-0.85 vs 0.33) and Tung Ptr1/Ptr8, but broad: use as a zone marker, not alone.
WOX4 paralog; broad in Chen 2021 cambium-region clusters (0.77-0.94 vs 0.44) and Schmidt 2025 c4/c5 (0.63 vs 0.21).

PXY receptor for TDIF/CLE41 that maintains cambial division (Etchells et al. 2015 Curr Biol, Populus); xylem-side cambium in Chen 2021 cl5 (0.80/0.32) and Schmidt 2025 c4/c5/c22 (0.70-0.79 vs 0.23-0.26); broad. Li 2021 used the paralog Potri.003G107600.
Class III HD-ZIP regulating cambium differentiation (Zhu et al. 2013 New Phytol); Schmidt 2025 c10 cambium (0.41/0.11) and Li 2021 cl4.

AINTEGUMENTA marks cambial stem cells in Arabidopsis; Schmidt 2025 c10 (0.68/0.11) and developing phloem c17; absent from debarked-xylem protoplasts (Tung 2023), consistent with removal of initials with the bark.
Serine carboxypeptidase-like; promoter::GUS in cambium and juvenile xylem of 717 internodes 4-10 (Schmidt 2025 Fig S3); Schmidt c4 (0.74/0.05); broad in Chen 2021 (cl2/5/8, pct.out 0.16-0.18).
Class III HD-ZIP (ATHB8 ortholog) of xylem specification; Schmidt 2025 c4 (0.42/0.09) and Li 2021 cl4 (candidate cambial zone/XMC).

Papain-like protease of tracheary-element autolysis (Avci et al. 2008 Plant J); vessel LCM (Tung 2023: V 2332 vs F 40, R 44 TPM), Schmidt 2025 vessel-PCD c25 (1.00/0.08), Li 2021 cl7 (log2FC 6.9), in situ in mature xylem zone (Wei 2026). Conflict: Tung protoplast cluster Ptr7 (fiber) and Chen et al. 2024 LCM correlation put Li cl7 with fibers.
XCP2 paralog; vessel LCM (Tung 2023: V 1968 vs F 168, R 12), Schmidt 2025 c25 (0.92/0.04), Li 2021 cl7 (log2FC 6.6).
XCP1 tracheary-element PCD protease; specific in Schmidt 2025 c25 (0.42/0.01) and Li 2021 cl7 (log2FC 5.3); not among Tung vessel LCM DEGs.
Bifunctional nuclease of xylem PCD (AtBFN1); Schmidt 2025 c25 only (0.75/0.01). Also in fiber PCD in Arabidopsis.
VND-family NAC master regulator of vessel differentiation; Schmidt 2025 c13 (0.87/0.07, vessel+fiber SCW cluster). Not vessel-specific in Tung protoplasts (Ptr6/Ptr7).

Thermospermine synthase that delays vessel PCD; PttACL5 in situ in vessel elements (Milhinhos et al. 2013 Plant J). Here enriched in early xylem: Tung Ptr1 vessel (log2FC 3.4), Chen 2021 cl5, Schmidt 2025 c4, Li 2021 cl4/10; Wei 2026 in situ in layers 5-15 (not cell-resolved).

ACL5 paralog; Tung Ptr1 vessel (log2FC 4.0), Chen 2021 cl5 (0.33/0.01), Schmidt 2025 c4 (0.18/0.03), Li 2021 cl4/cl10. Early (expanding) vessels and xylem mother cells. Qi 2026 (Plant Cell) uses it as the marker of early xylem ray precursors XRP_1, with in situ in ray cambial and developing ray cells (from a summary of the article page; not seen), so it is not vessel-specific: not raised.
Endo-1,4-beta-mannanase; vessel LCM (Tung 2023: V 1437 vs F 10, R 9), Schmidt 2025 c25 (1.00/0.04), Li 2021 cl7 (log2FC 7.1).
Lignin laccase; vessel LCM (Tung 2023: V 253 vs F 3, R 2), Li 2021 cl7 (expr 7.6 vs <0.35), Schmidt 2025 c25 (0.25/0.02).

WAT1-related transporter; in situ with vessel arrow (Wei 2026 Fig 5d), vessel LCM (Tung 2023: V 329 vs F 25, R 71), Tung Ptr1. Broad in whole-stem data (Chen cl5 0.81/0.20; Schmidt c7/c4, pct.out 0.55).
Pectate-lyase-like (uncharacterized); vessel LCM (Tung 2023: V 913 vs F 33, R 13), Schmidt 2025 c25 (1.00/0.04), Li 2021 cl7 (log2FC 7.6). Tung protoplasts place it in Ptr7.
Endo-polygalacturonase (uncharacterized); vessel LCM (Tung 2023: V 624 vs F 9, R 0), Schmidt 2025 c25 (1.00/0.01), Li 2021 cl7 (log2FC 6.6).

DUF579 xylan-synthesis protein; fiber LCM (Tung 2023: F 1630 vs R 79, V 193), exclusive to Tung fiber cluster Ptr7, Chen 2021 cl4 (0.52/0.03), Li 2021 SCW clusters; broad in Schmidt nuclei (0.62/0.25).

Fasciclin-like arabinogalactan protein of SCW fibers (AtFLA11/12, MacMillan et al. 2010 Plant J); fiber LCM (Tung 2023: F 1726 vs R 12, V 21), Tung Ptr7, in situ in SCW layers 12-18 (Wei 2026). Weak in nuclei (Wei pct 0.84 vs 0.79).
Chitinase-like GH19 needed for SCW cellulose (AtCTL1/2); in situ with fiber arrow (Wei 2026 Fig 5d), Tung Ptr7 (log2FC 7.4), Chen 2021 cl4 (0.98/0.07). Broad in Schmidt nuclei (0.89/0.65).
Glucomannan synthase; fiber LCM (Tung 2023: F 5659 vs R 192, V 552), Li 2021 fiber cl2 (5.7) > cl7, Chen 2021 cl4 (0.77/0.01).

Ferulate 5-hydroxylase for syringyl lignin, which dominates fiber walls; fiber LCM (Tung 2023: F 1712 vs R 120, V 193), Chen 2021 cl4 (0.39/0.03), Li 2021 cl2/7. Broad in Schmidt nuclei (also epidermis c6).
F5H paralog for syringyl lignin; Li 2021 fiber cl2 (log2FC 7.0) with an in situ probe (images not seen) and fiber-LMD agreement; broad in Schmidt nuclei (0.60/0.29); not a Tung fiber LCM DEG.

SND1/NST3 NAC master switch of fiber SCW (Zhong et al. 2011, Populus); Schmidt 2025 fiber-biased c3 (0.33/0.10), Li 2021 cl6, Tung Ptr7; broad in Chen 2021 (cl1/cl4, pct.out 0.16-0.20). Also in vessels at lower level.
Uncharacterized; fiber LCM (Tung 2023: F 39 vs R 0, V 0), Schmidt 2025 c3 (0.27/0.03), Li 2021 cl6, Chen 2021 cl4 (0.71/0.12).
DNA-3-methyladenine glycosylase I (uncharacterized in wood); fiber LCM (Tung 2023: F 138 vs R 8, V 3), Chen 2021 cl4 (0.58/0.01), Schmidt 2025 c3/c13 (0.49-0.68 vs 0.09), Li 2021 cl2/6.

Aspartic protease (AT2G03200-like); fiber LCM (Tung 2023: F 1851 vs R 88, V 318), Tung Ptr7 (log2FC 7.2), Chen 2021 cl4 (0.90/0.04), Li 2021 fiber cl2/6, Schmidt 2025 c3/c13. Tung calls it a known fiber marker (PtAP66, cited from Chen); AP66 identity not confirmed.
Fasciclin-like AGP; fiber LCM (Tung 2023: F 1071 vs R 2, V 6) and Ptr7 (log2FC 7.5); only weak elsewhere (Schmidt 2025 c13 0.20/0.07). Single study; useful to split fiber from vessel.
Fasciclin-like AGP; fiber LCM (Tung 2023: F 1231 vs R 3, V 6) and Ptr7 (log2FC 6.1); weak in Schmidt 2025 c13 (0.23/0.05). Single study.

Xylan O-acetyltransferase of secondary walls; in situ in SCW xylem (Chen 2021 Fig 3F; used as fiber marker by Tung 2023), Chen cl4 (0.67/0.04), Li SCW clusters 2/6/7, Schmidt c3/c13 (0.65-0.72 vs 0.13-0.15), Tung Ptr7. Fiber-biased.
Secondary-wall cellulose synthase; Chen 2021 cl4 (0.95/0.05), Li 2021 cl2/6/7, Schmidt 2025 c3/c13, fiber-biased in LCM (Tung 2023: F 5487, V 907, R 308).
Secondary-wall cellulose synthase; Chen 2021 cl4 (0.72/0.03), Schmidt 2025 c3 (0.72/0.20) and c13, Li 2021 SCW clusters, Tung Ptr7. Paralog CesA8-B = Potri.004G059600 behaves the same.
MYB46/83 secondary-wall switch; Li 2021 cl6 (log2FC 3.4), Schmidt 2025 c3 (0.30/0.03), Chen 2021 cl4 (0.63/0.12), Tung Ptr7. Chen called a different gene MYB46 (Potri.001G258700, PtrMYB2).
MYB46/83-clade secondary-wall MYB; Schmidt 2025 c3 (0.27/0.03), Li 2021 cl6 (log2FC 3.9), Tung Ptr7.
KNOX SCW regulator; promoter::GUS in secondary-xylem vessels and fibers (Schmidt 2025 Fig S4), Schmidt c3/c13 (0.52-0.63 vs 0.10), Chen 2021 cl4 (0.83/0.07), Tung Ptr7.
Xylan glucuronosyltransferase of secondary walls; Schmidt 2025 c13 (0.85/0.10), Chen 2021 cl4 (0.60/0.01), Li 2021 cl2/7.

SCW cellulose synthase (AtCESA7/IRX3 homolog); Chen 2021 cl4 (0.77/0.02), Li 2021 fiber/vessel cl2/6/7 (log2FC 5.5), Schmidt 2025 c13 (0.97/0.24) and c3, fiber LCM (Tung 2023: F 4489 vs R 116, V 838) and Ptr7 (log2FC 7.8). Not in UniProt under POPTR_ (v3-to-v4 rename not checked); the ID is in the Chen, Schmidt and Tung tables.
MYB59-like TF; promoter::GUS in vessel-associated (contact) parenchyma of stem and root, and myb48 knockouts make more, larger vessels (Schmidt 2025 Fig 4, S5); c7 (0.86/0.05). Single study.
MYB48 paralog (co-targeted in the knockout); Schmidt 2025 VAC c7 (0.94/0.12) and ray LCM (Tung 2023: R 757 vs F 34, V 140). Covers ray/contact parenchyma.

AP2/ERF; in situ in xylem parenchyma (Chen 2021 Fig 3E), Chen cl9 (0.99/0.07); also Li 2021 stress-state cl5 (RcIII). ABA/wound-inducible, so the Li agreement may be shared protoplasting stress; Tung 2023 cites the same in situ as organizer-cell location.
Phosphate exporter that loads xylem from parenchyma (AtPHO1); Schmidt 2025 VAC c7 (0.67/0.07), MYB48 co-expression module.
Class III peroxidase; AtPRX47 is expressed in xylem parenchyma and lignifies neighbouring vessels (Tokunaga et al. 2009); Schmidt 2025 c7 (0.68/0.04).
Mannitol dehydrogenase/CAD-like; Chen 2021 xylem-parenchyma cl9 (0.94/0.14) and stress cl8.
Tonoplast intrinsic protein; ray LCM (Tung 2023: R 67 vs F 0, V 0); specific in Chen 2021 wood-side cl10 (0.67/0.04), which supports cl10 = ray parenchyma.

ACT-domain bHLH-like (uncharacterized); ray LCM (Tung 2023: R 261 vs F 3, V 0) and Tung Ptr8; in whole-stem data also in ground/bark parenchyma (Schmidt c9 0.50/0.11; Chen cl7/cl17), so ray-specific only within wood.

Lipid-transfer-like protein; in situ in ray cambial cells and developing xylem ray cells, marker of xylem ray precursor XRP_2 (Qi et al. 2026 Plant Cell, Fig. 5h, from a summary of the article page; figure and ID not seen), and independently the top gene of the LCM-backed ray cluster Ptr8 (Tung 2023: log2FC 5.4, mean UMI 9.8). Also high in unassigned Schmidt 2025 c20/c22. Not raised to high until the in situ and ID are confirmed from the paper.
Uncharacterized; ray LCM (Tung 2023: R 8199 vs F 227, V 444) and Ptr8 (log2FC 5.4); Li 2021 ray/parenchyma cl3/cl8. Broad in whole stem (Schmidt 2025 pct.out 0.55): within wood only.

Uncharacterized; ray LCM (Tung 2023: R 15810 vs F 313, V 898) and Ptr8 (log2FC 4.1); Chen 2021 cl10 (1.00/0.41) and xylem parenchyma cl9, Li 2021 cl8/cl11. Parenchyma-wide and broad (pct.out 0.4-0.8): use within wood only.
Non-specific LTP; ray LCM (Tung 2023: R 1194 vs F 31, V 82) and Ptr8 (log2FC 4.3); Li 2021 cl8/cl11. Also Schmidt 2025 c20 (unassigned).
Thioredoxin-like; Tung 2023 Ptr8 (log2FC 4.3, mean UMI 1.5) and ray LCM (review: R 2345 vs F 68, V 222); Chen 2021 cl10 (0.86/0.15), Li 2021 cl3. Broad in Schmidt 2025 (pct.out 0.30).
Phosphoglycerate-mutase-like; ray LCM (Tung 2023: R 127 vs F 0, V 0) and Ptr8 (log2FC 7.4). Single study (LCM + scRNA); weak in Schmidt 2025 ground tissue c0/c2.
Uncharacterized; ray LCM (Tung 2023: R 20 vs F 0, V 0) and Ptr8 (log2FC 8.7). Single study; low expression.
Uncharacterized; ray LCM (Tung 2023: R 45 vs F 0, V 0) and Ptr8 (log2FC 7.3). Single study; also Schmidt 2025 epidermis c6 (0.30/0.02).
UMAMIT-like transporter; ray LCM (Tung 2023: R 56 vs F 0.5, V 0) and Ptr8 (log2FC 7.2). Also Schmidt 2025 phloem parenchyma c12 (0.22/0.02), which may hold phloem rays. Single study for xylem rays.
LysM receptor-like kinase; ray LCM (Tung 2023: R 163 vs F 5, V 0) and Ptr8 (log2FC 5.6). Single study.
CrRLK1L-like kinase; ray LCM (Tung 2023: R 61 vs F 0, V 0) and Ptr8 (log2FC 5.1). Single study.
FHA-domain protein; ray LCM (Tung 2023: R 29 vs F 0, V 0) and Ptr8 (log2FC 6.2). Single study; in no other dataset table.

MYB-CC TF required for phloem (SE + CC) identity (Bonke et al. 2003 Nature); in situ in phloem (Chen 2021 Fig 2C), Chen CC cl13 (0.79/0.01) and SE cl19 (0.78/0.02), Schmidt 2025 CC c18 (0.66/0.03) and developing phloem c17.
APL paralog; Chen 2021 cl13 (0.38/0.005), Schmidt 2025 c17 (0.30/0.01) and c18.

SMXL5 promotes early phloem formation (Wallner et al. 2017 Curr Biol); developing phloem in Chen 2021 cl6 (0.52/0.04) and Schmidt 2025 c17 (0.61/0.03). Marks phloem-side cambial derivatives, not mature phloem.
SMXL5 paralog; Chen 2021 cl6 (0.62/0.04), Schmidt 2025 c17 (0.53/0.05). Developing phloem.
Phloem lectin PP2-A1 (companion-cell promoter in Arabidopsis); Chen 2021 cl13 (0.82/0.002) and Schmidt 2025 c18 (0.87/0.07).
PP2-like phloem lectin; Chen 2021 cl13 (0.42/0.002) and Schmidt 2025 c18 (0.89/0.07). Chen called Potri.012G120300 "PP2-A10"; it is a different paralog.
Sucrose transporter, best hit AtSUC2; Chen 2021 cl13 (0.35/0.001), not in Schmidt tables. Poplar loads phloem passively, so a SUC2-type role is unproven.

Sucrose transporter; companion-cell cluster in Schmidt 2025 c18 (0.51/0.08) and Chen 2021 cl13 (0.91/0.16), but also SCW xylem (Chen cl4, Schmidt c3, fiber LCM F 462 vs R 54, V 47 in Tung 2023). Not CC-specific; check against fiber markers.

Sieve-element occlusion protein forming SE filaments (Froelich et al. 2011 Plant Cell); Chen 2021 cl19 (0.98/0.007); weak in Schmidt nuclei (c17 0.27/0.08). Developing SEs only; enucleate SEs absent from nuclei data.
SEOR1 paralog; Chen 2021 cl19 (1.00/0.02); weak in Schmidt c14/c17 (0.24-0.28 vs 0.09).
Callose synthase 7 for sieve-plate callose (Xie et al. 2011 Plant Physiol); Chen 2021 cl19 (0.93/0.04), Schmidt 2025 c17 (0.31/0.03). Schmidt c24 also (0.50/0.04).
Early nodulin-like phytocyanin of SE plasma membrane (Arabidopsis); Chen 2021 cl19 (0.73/0.001); Schmidt c18 CC (0.38/0.06).
UMAMIT amino-acid exporter, the class that marks phloem parenchyma in Arabidopsis leaf (Kim et al. 2021 Plant Cell); Schmidt 2025 c12 (0.99/0.12) and Chen 2021 cl18 (0.62/0.001).
UMAMIT exporter; Chen 2021 cl18 (1.00/0.03) and Schmidt 2025 c12 (0.77/0.12); also Schmidt VAC c7 (0.35/0.13).
UMAMIT exporter; Chen 2021 cl18 (0.94/0.002) and Schmidt 2025 c12 (0.47/0.05).
UMAMIT exporter (AT1G21890 clade); Chen 2021 cl18 (1.00/0.02) and Schmidt 2025 c12 (0.78/0.11).

SCARECROW, needed for shoot endodermis and gravitropism (SGR1; Fukaki et al. 1998 Plant J); Chen 2021 cl17 (0.94/0.003; best Arabidopsis hit SCL23) and Schmidt 2025 c15 (0.78/0.04). Both papers mislabelled the cluster (CEI; phellogen).
LAZY1 acts in shoot endodermis for gravitropism (Yoshihara et al. 2013 Plant Cell Physiol); Chen 2021 cl17 (0.96/0.016) and Schmidt 2025 c15 (0.41/0.016).
LAZY1 paralog; Chen 2021 cl17 (0.78/0.000) and Schmidt 2025 c15 (0.75/0.05).
SHORT-ROOT homolog; Schmidt 2025 c15 (0.52/0.07). UniProt entry U5FI43 also lists Potri.017G025900, which Chen found broad (cl0/12/17).
HD-ZIP IV GLABRA2 of epidermal cell fate; Chen 2021 cl12 (0.41/0.03); Schmidt 2025 c16/c9 (0.30-0.36 vs 0.07).
HD-ZIP IV PDF2 (L1 identity with ATML1); Schmidt 2025 c6 (0.21/0.002).
FIDDLEHEAD epidermal KCS for cuticle (Yephremov et al. 1999 Plant Cell); Schmidt 2025 c6 (1.00/0.33, broad background).
Epidermal cuticular-wax elongase KCS6/CER6; Schmidt 2025 c6 (0.95/0.13) and c23.
Fatty acyl-CoA reductase of wax primary alcohols; Schmidt 2025 c6 (0.67/0.015).
ABCG32/PEC1 cuticle transporter; Schmidt 2025 c6 (0.67/0.09). Chen 2021 found it in phellem cl11 (0.35/0.003): marks the outer protective layer at either stage.
Class III peroxidase (AtPRX72 lignification); Chen 2021 cork cl11 (0.52/0.008). Single study; periderm absent at Schmidt LPI 4-5.
Class III peroxidase; Chen 2021 cork cl11 (0.37/0.03) but Schmidt 2025 epidermis c6 (0.86/0.10): outer-layer marker, not periderm-specific.
ABCG32/PEC1 lipid-barrier transporter; Chen 2021 cork cl11 (0.35/0.003); epidermis in Schmidt 2025 (c6). Use with suberin genes.

Plant-specific G2/M CDK; Chen 2021 cl14/15 (0.72/0.04), Li 2021 dividing cl9, Schmidt 2025 c8 (0.60/0.03). Qi 2026 (Plant Cell) used it as the "fusiform initial" marker, in situ in fusiform and ray cambial cells (from a summary; not seen): a G2/M state, not fusiform identity.
Cytokinesis syntaxin SYP111; Chen 2021 cl15 (0.46/0.005), Schmidt 2025 c8 (0.42/0.045).
Mitotic B-type cyclin; Chen 2021 cl14/15 (0.52/0.013), Schmidt 2025 c8 (0.53/0.04).

Chalcone-isomerase-family protein (AT5G66230 hit); Chen 2021 cl14/15 (0.50/0.01) and Schmidt 2025 c8 (0.33/0.03). Qi 2026 (Plant Cell) used it as the "ray initial" RIC_2 marker, in situ in ray cambial cells (from a summary; not seen): a proliferation state, not ray identity.
Replication-coupled histone H2A; Chen 2021 cl14 (0.68/0.04), Li 2021 cl9 (in situ probe), Schmidt 2025 c8 (0.44/0.09) and cambium c10.
DNA sliding clamp of replication; Li 2021 cl9 and Schmidt 2025 cambium c10 (0.34/0.05), showing cycling cells inside the "cambial initials" cluster.

Replication-coupled histone H2B (AT2G37470 hit); Li 2021 dividing cl9 and Schmidt 2025 c8 (0.34/0.11) and cambium c10. Qi 2026 (Plant Cell) used it as the "ray initial" RIC_1 marker (in situ in ray cambial cells, from a summary). Not in UniProt; ID from Li and Schmidt tables.
